mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_agent_memory(memory_code,namespace_code,agent_code,scope_type,scope_code,memory_level,content,tags_json, source_type,source_ref,confidence,importance,expires_at,created_by_key_id,idempotency_key) VALUES(#{code},#{namespace},#{agent},#{scopeType},#{scopeCode},#{level},#{content},CAST(#{tagsJson} AS JSON), #{sourceType},#{sourceRef},#{confidence},#{importance},#{expiresAt},#{keyId},#{idempotencyKey}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=id
mapper.select: SELECT memory_code memoryCode,expires_at expiresAt,scope_type scopeType,scope_code scopeCode, memory_level memoryLevel,content FROM t_agent_memory WHERE namespace_code=#{namespace} AND agent_code=#{agent} AND idempotency_key=#{idempotencyKey} LIMIT 1

SELECT memory_code memoryCode,namespace_code namespaceCode,agent_code agentCode,scope_type scopeType, scope_code scopeCode,memory_level memoryLevel,content,tags_json tags,source_type sourceType,source_ref sourceRef, confidence,importance,expires_at expiresAt,created_time createdTime,updated_time updatedTime, (CASE WHEN content LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query},'%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 10 + importance * confidence AS relevanceScore FROM t_agent_memory WHERE namespace_code=#{namespace} AND status='ACTIVE' AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND ((scope_type='AGENT' AND agent_code=#{agent}) OR (scope_type=#{scopeType} AND scope_code=#{scopeCode})) AND (content LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query},'%') OR CAST(tags_json AS CHAR) LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query},'%')) ORDER BY relevanceScore DESC,importance DESC,updated_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT memory_code memoryCode,namespace_code namespaceCode,agent_code agentCode,scope_type scopeType, scope_code scopeCode,memory_level memoryLevel,content,tags_json tags,source_type sourceType,source_ref sourceRef, confidence,importance,expires_at expiresAt,status,created_time createdTime,updated_time updatedTime FROM t_agent_memory WHERE namespace_code=#{namespace} AND memory_code=#{code} LIMIT 1
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM t_agent_memory WHERE expires_at IS NOT NULL AND expires_at < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND (memory_level='L0' OR expires_at < DATE_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, INTERVAL 30 DAY))
